messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api us-east-1 GPU pool queue depth rising fast. queue=2300 reqs, p95=4.5s (was 1.2s), p99=6.8s, 503s from autoscaler throttles. paging oncall.
jordan: ack. paging @maya oncall now. :rotating_light:
maya: oncall here, looking. any obvious customer campaign?
devon: checking logs, seeing provisioner errors when creating nodes: cloud api 429 / quotaExceeded on instanceCreate. autoscaler stuck retrying.
maya: can we route traffic to other regions or dedicated? how many spare dedicated GPUs?
sara: Dedicated pool has ~6 spare gpus but needs manual toggle to accept hosted routing. can do if we agree.
natalie: FYI some heavy customers (cust-alpha, cust-bravo) are at 10x normal qps — likely batch jobs.
devon: tail of provisioner log:
```
2026-03-17T04:12:01Z provisioner: createInstance failed: quotaExceeded
2026-03-17T04:12:02Z provisioner: retrying (attempt=4)
2026-03-17T04:12:05Z provisioner: cloud API 429: RateLimitExceeded
```

maya: quick mitigation plan: 1) enable degraded-mode to lower max_tokens for hosted models 2) apply temp rate-limits to heaviest tenants 3) route non-SLA traffic to redwood-compact model pool 4) page cloud-ops for quota bump / API rate troubleshoot. who can do (1) and (2) fast?
jordan: I'll push rate-limit rule for top offenders. executing admin API.
jordan: ```curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/admin/rate_limit -d '{"tenant":"cust-alpha","rps":20}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'```
ops-bot: rate limit applied for cust-alpha and cust-bravo, aggregate incoming RPS down ~36% in 3m.
natalie: applying routing change for non-SLA traffic to redwood-compact now (console changes).
devon: cloud-ops joined: @cloud-ops, are you seeing API throttling on our project?
cloud-ops: seeing elevated instanceCreate errors from our service account; looks like global create-rate limit from provider. we can request quota increase but takes 30-60m. we can also try staggered requests — devon can throttle provisioner concurrency.
devon: lowered provisioner concurrency from 12 -> 3. issuing manual scale request for 4 nodes to open fast path.
ops-bot: manual create submitted, 2 nodes succeeded, 2 pending. queue depth: 2300 -> 980 after 6m.
maya: enabling degraded-mode now (max_tokens halved) to reduce per-request GPU time.
ops-bot: degraded-mode enabled, avg token rate down. queue depth -> 600 in 12m. p95 -> 420ms, p99 -> 860ms. 5xxs trending down.
sara: Dedicated pool accepted hosted routing; shifting a few high latency shards over.
cloud-ops: provider acknowledged rate limit and temporarily raised burst for us (30m window). provisioning throughput improving.
devon: all 4 manual nodes are up, autoscaler resumed normal ops. provisioner logs show backoff retries succeeding.
ops-bot: final metrics snapshot: queue=120, p95=200ms, p99=450ms, 5xx rate ~0.1/min.
maya: marking incident resolved (mitigated) for now. will open postmortem: need provider quota request and autoscaler backoff improvements + whitelist for emergency dedicated routing.
jordan: created ticket INF-2026: request provider create-rate increase + add circuit to fail open to dedicated pool.
natalie: will follow up with customer outreach to top offenders to recommend pacing.
sara: :thumbsup: nice coordination.
ops-bot: incident resolved by team actions at 2026-03-17T04:44:36Z.
maya: closing thread — will post RCA draft in #postmortems in 24h. :spiral_note_pad:
